title: int:UserPreferences
description: Actor-level UI, notification, and FOS trading preferences. One-to-one with UserAccount.

accountId.description: FK to UserAccount (primary key). IRI: foaf:accountId. UUID v4.

language.description: Preferred UI language. IRI: int:language. IETF BCP 47 tag.

timezone.description: Preferred timezone. IRI: int:timezone. IANA TZ database name.

currencyDisplay.description: Preferred display currency. IRI: int:currencyDisplay. ISO 4217.

dashboardLayout.description: Preferred dashboard layout mode. IRI: int:dashboardLayout.

notificationsEnabled.description: Master notification opt-in. GDPR consent flag. IRI: int:notificationsEnabled.

tradeAlerts.description: Receive alerts on trade match/settlement. IRI: int:tradeAlerts.

billingAlerts.description: Receive notifications for new invoices and payment due. IRI: int:billingAlerts.

FOSobjective.description: High-level FOS trading objective. IRI: int:FOSObjective.

dataShareConsent.description: GDPR consent to share data with research partners. Default FALSE. IRI: int:dataShareConsent.

comfortPriority.description: Thermal comfort vs. cost trade-off in FOS. IRI: int:comfortPriority.

riskAversion.description: Actor preference for trading risk under uncertainty. IRI: int:riskAversion.

energySourcePreference.description: Preferred energy generation sources for trades. IRI: int:energySourcePreference. Comma-separated.

tradingPartnerPreference.description: Preferred trading partner IDs. IRI: int:tradingPartnerPreference.

targetIndoorTemperature.description: Actor setpoint for ideal indoor temperature. IRI: int:targetIndoorTemperature. Unit: °C.

maxIndoorTemperature.description: Maximum allowable indoor temperature for cost minimisation. IRI: int:maxIndoorTemperature. Unit: °C.

minIndoorTemperature.description: Minimum allowable indoor temperature for cost minimisation. IRI: int:minIndoorTemperature. Unit: °C.

targetDepartureEVSOC.description: Desired EV state of charge at departure time (0-1). IRI: int:targetDepartureEVSOC. Unit: %.

minimumEVSOC.description: Minimum EV SOC to maintain at all times (0-1). IRI: int:minimumEVSOC. Unit: %.

targetDepartureTime.description: Expected time of next EV departure. IRI: int:targetDepartureTime. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. IRI: int:updatedAt. ISO 8601 with timezone.
